raw.details:
Organised by InfoTechiezz in collaboration with Thozhil

Think Logically. Code Smartly. Win Big.

Are you ready to test your coding skills and challenge your problem-solving abilities?

Join the Reverse Coding Challenge 2026, an online coding competition designed to evaluate your logical thinking, programming fundamentals, algorithmic knowledge, and Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) skills.

Compete with fellow students and developers, solve challenging coding problems, and earn recognition for your performance.

Competition Format:

Competition Type: Online Coding Challenge
Total Rounds: 1
Duration: 90 Minutes
Total Problems: 4 DSA Problems
Registration Fee: Free
Mode: Online

Single Round — The Coding Battle

  • Participants must solve 4 DSA problems within the allotted 90 minutes.
  • Your performance will be evaluated based on solution correctness, test cases passed, and the official judging and tie-breaking rules.
  • Use your coding skills, logical reasoning, and time management to achieve the highest possible score.

Eligibility Criteria

The competition is open to:

  • College students.
  • Freshers and recent graduates.
  • Working professionals.
  • School students with programming knowledge.
  • Coding enthusiasts interested in improving their DSA skills.

Participants should have basic programming knowledge and an understanding of problem-solving techniques.

Participation Type: Individual participation.

Rules and Guidelines

  • Participants must register through the official opportunity registration portal.
  • The competition consists of one round with 4 DSA problems.
  • The total time limit is 90 minutes.
  • Participants must submit their solutions before the competition ends.
  • Only submissions made through the designated coding platform will be considered for evaluation.
  • Rankings will be determined using the official scoring, test-case evaluation, and tie-breaking rules.
  • Plagiarism, copied solutions, impersonation, or other unfair practices may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must follow the competition instructions and platform guidelines.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring a stable internet connection and submitting their solutions on time.
  • The organiser reserves the right to resolve disputes and make final decisions regarding competition results in accordance with the published rules.

Rewards and Recognition:

  • Top 3 Performers — Exciting Gifts!
  • The Top 3 participants will receive exciting gifts in recognition of their outstanding coding performance, problem-solving skills, and achievement in the competition.
  • Internship Opportunity for the Top 3
  • The Top 3 performers will also have the opportunity to compete for a free internship with InfoTechiezz, subject to the organiser's eligibility criteria and applicable terms.
  • Participants should demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, coding proficiency, and a willingness to learn.
  • Internship opportunities are subject to the organiser's eligibility criteria and applicable terms.

Why Participate?

  • Test your coding and algorithmic thinking skills.
  • Compete with students and developers from different institutions.
  • Improve your problem-solving speed and coding efficiency.
  • Gain valuable competitive programming experience.
  • Challenge yourself with DSA problems under time constraints.
  • Earn recognition for your performance.
  • Explore potential internship opportunities.
  • Connect with a community focused on programming and technology.

Skills to Be Assessed

The challenge is designed to assess the following skills:

  • Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA).
  • Problem Solving.
  • Logical Reasoning.
  • Programming Fundamentals.
  • Algorithm Design.
  • Code Efficiency.
  • Time and Space Complexity.
  • Analytical Thinking.

Bonus Rewards & Exclusive Benefits

Follow InfoTechiezz on its official platforms to discover additional coding preparation resources, community activities, and learning opportunities.

Participants who complete the applicable social-media follow and subscription requirements may become eligible for additional benefits.

How to Claim Bonus Benefits:

  • Follow InfoTechiezz on its official social media platforms.
  • Subscribe to the InfoTechiezz YouTube channel.
  • Take screenshots as proof of completion.
  • Send your screenshots to admin@infotechiezz.com.
  • Wait for verification by the organiser.
  • Additional benefits are subject to verification and availability.
  • What You May Get
  • After verification, eligible participants may receive:
  • Tips and strategies for coding rounds.
  • Coding tricks and shortcuts.
  • Guidance on approaching algorithmic problems.
  • Additional DSA practice resources.
  • Special coding preparation content.
  • Learning resources to improve programming skills.

Extra Learning Benefits

Subscribe to the InfoTechiezz YouTube channel for:

  • Coding tutorials.
  • Data Structures and Algorithms preparation.
  • Problem-solving strategies.
  • Programming tips and techniques.
  • Competitive programming guidance.
  • Coding contest preparation resources.

Future Premium Contest Benefits

Active community members may receive additional benefits in upcoming contests, subject to availability and applicable terms.

Potential benefits include:

  • Exclusive coupon codes.
  • Discounted entry passes for eligible future contests.
  • Priority reward opportunities.
  • Premium coding preparation materials.
  • Access to selected learning resources.

These benefits are not guaranteed and may vary by contest.

Refer & Earn

Invite your friends to follow InfoTechiezz and participate in the Reverse Coding Challenge 2026.

Share the opportunity with fellow students, developers, and coding enthusiasts.

Eligible referrals may unlock surprise rewards and exclusive benefits, subject to the organiser's referral rules and verification.

Stay Connected with InfoTechiezz

  • Follow our official platforms for coding preparation content, contest announcements, results, learning resources, and future opportunities.
  • Website
    https://www.infotechiezz.com/
  • YouTube
    https://www.youtube.com/@InfoTechiezz

  • Contact Email: admin@infotechiezz.com

Event Summary

  • Event: Reverse Coding Challenge 2026
  • Organiser: InfoTechiezz
  • In Collaboration With: Thozhil
  • Date: 31 October 2026
  • Mode: Online
  • Rounds: 1
  • Duration: 90 minutes
  • Problems: 4 DSA problems
  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Top Rewards: Exciting gifts for the Top 3 performers
  • Additional Opportunity: Opportunity to compete for a free internship, subject to eligibility and applicable terms

Ready to Take the Challenge?

Prepare your logic, sharpen your coding skills, and get ready to compete.

Register now. Solve smart. Climb the leaderboard. Earn your recognition.

InfoTechiezz — Learn. Code. Compete. Grow.
